gloss: the only; the sole; the one and only

definitions.gloss: the only (one of its kind); the sole; the single
definitions.explanation: An attributive phrase meaning "the only" or "the one and only." Formed from the noun {唯一|ゆいいつ} ("the only one; uniqueness") plus the attributive particle の. Used to single out one item from a larger set as the unique instance of a quality.

examples.japanese: {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{方法|ほうほう}。
{彼|かれ}は{唯一|ゆいいつ}の{友人|ゆうじん}だ。
これが、{問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}するための{唯一|ゆいいつ}の{手段|しゅだん}だ。
examples.english: This is the only means of solving the problem.

examples.japanese: この{村|むら}は{日本|にほん}で{唯一|ゆいいつ}のこの{伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}が{残|のこ}っている{場所|ばしょ}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: This village is said to be the only place in Japan where this traditional craft still survives.

notes:
A fixed attributive phrase built from the noun {唯一|ゆいいつ} ("the only one; uniqueness") + the attributive particle の. Always precedes a noun.

CORE PATTERN:
  {唯一|ゆいいつ}の + noun = "the only / sole + noun"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{方法|ほうほう}: the only way
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{手段|しゅだん}: the only means
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{答|こた}え: the only answer
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{例外|れいがい}: the sole exception
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{選択肢|せんたくし}: the only option
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{違|ちが}い: the only difference
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{希望|きぼう}: the one and only hope
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}{無二|むに}: one and only; unique (a four-character idiom built on the same root)

FORMS:
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}: the only one (bare noun; used as a predicate, e.g., X は{唯一|ゆいいつ}だ "X is the only one")
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}{無二|むに}: one and only; peerless; unique — a more emphatic four-character compound.
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の + noun: the ordinary attributive phrase.
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}と{言|い}っていい: practically the only
- X が{唯一|ゆいいつ}だ: X is the only one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ただ{一|ひと}つの: the one and only — native-Japanese phrasing, slightly softer than {唯一|ゆいいつ}の.
- ただ{一人|ひとり}の: the only person — specifically for people.
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の vs {一|ひと}つの: {一|ひと}つの simply counts "one"; {唯一|ゆいいつ}の asserts uniqueness.

USAGE:
{唯一|ゆいいつ}の is somewhat formal and emphatic. In everyday speech, speakers often soften it with ただ{一|ひと}つの or rephrase the sentence entirely. In writing, however, {唯一|ゆいいつ}の is the standard way to mark a unique instance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Though {唯一|ゆいいつ} is historically a noun, the phrase {唯一|ゆいいつ}の is so common that some dictionaries treat it as a bound prenominal modifier. It cannot stand alone — *{唯一|ゆいいつ}だけ is unnatural, as the meaning of "only" is already contained in the word.
